title.narrative: BCO has supported the Government International and National strategies on improving all forms of malnutrition, such as the Task Force for a Global Alliance Against Hunger and Poverty and discussions towards the WHA resolution on the regulation of digital marketing of breast-milk substitutes. Moreover, UNICEF supported the regulatory agenda of ultraprocessed foods, resulting in approval of a SSB taxation and 15 local laws for healthy schools. UNICEF is part of government strategies on nutrition in emergencies, such as the development of anIndigenous Food Systems analysis tool, community IMCI training in indigenous settings that indirectly reached 32,000 children, also responding to climate emergencies such as droughts and floods. In this context, it is important to improve nutrition information systems, for which UNICEF trained 4,857 professionals.;
